release_notes:
feat(migrator): complete GSM Tool migration, SMS-ready + active users

Bring the database migrator to full fidelity so a migrated site needs no
manual post-fixes.

Data completeness (GSM Tool importer):
- Import previously-skipped tables: userlog, user_login_log, retail_orders,
  retail_payments, payment_details, paypal_payments, package_custom_fields
  (FK-remapped through the migration map; config/leaf tables preserve their
  primary keys via a new preservePk flag).

Correctness:
- Re-encrypt per-user cipher columns (payments.Credits, payments.Amount,
  credit_history.CreditsLeft) with the new UserId, so admin overview totals
  decrypt instead of throwing "int + string" fatals.
- Convert legacy reversible (theString_Encrypt) passwords to phpass, so
  migrated customers keep their existing logins.

Customer profiles:
- Normalize phone numbers to E.164 ("+<cc><national>") from the account
  country so SMS gateways accept them. Phone.php promoted to a shared
  helper used by both the GSM Tool and Dhru importers.
- Force every migrated customer active (DisableUser=0, UserArchived=0) and
  onto the modern client dashboard (CPanel=0) — GSM Tool and Dhru.

Housekeeping:
- Remove the debug dump-to-webroot copy from dbmigrator.php.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
